## Slaughtermaw Lamprey (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
N Large animal [probably meant to be vermin] (aquatic)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 9, flat-footed 19 (+0 Dex, +10 natural,-1 size)  
**hp** 195 (15d8+75)  
**Fort** +13 **Ref** +11 **Will** +10  
**Defensive Abilities** from the depths; Resist cold 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 15 ft., swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** bite +18 (2d6+7/19-20 plus attach and bleed), tail slap +12 (1d8+3 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** bleed (1d6), feed, poison (DC 21), shattering fangs  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 10, **Con** 18, **Int** 2, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +11; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 29 (cannot be tripped)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (bite), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Iron Will](../../rules/feats/iron-will.md), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +4, Perception +12, Stealth +11, Swim +18; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim, +4 Stealth  
**SQ** from the depths  


**Special Abilities**


**Feed (Ex)** When a slaughtermaw lamprey makes a successful bite attack and attaches itself, it gains fast healing 5 so long as it is attached.  

**From the Depths (Ex)** The lamprey primarily lives within the ocean trenches of Orbis Aurea. They have cold resistance 10 and are immune to the crushing damage of the deepest parts of the ocean.  

**Poison (Ex)** Injury—bite; *save* Fort DC 21; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d6 Con damage; *cure* 1 save.  

**Shattering Fangs (Ex)** The teeth of a slaughtermaw lamprey are extremely tough and razor sharp, fully capable of penetrating the thickest of hides or armors with ease. Their powerful teeth have a natural ability to bypass hardness when sundering weapons or attacking objects, ignoring hardness less than 15. Furthermore, their bite deals an additional 2d6 points of damage to objects.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** cold aquatic  
**Organization** solitary or pair  
**Treasure** none
